pages.title: Tidal Alloy Scrap
pages.text: Metal stretched thin by tidal forces stronger than its chemical bonds: spaghettification in action. It is long, thin and flexible, and still faintly stretched in one direction. It feels like it is being pulled.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Tidal Horrors inside black holes dropped this scrap when they fell. I recognised it as metal that had been stretched apart by gravity's gradient.

Made in $(item)Kugelblitz Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Tidal Ore$(), in veins through the black hole interior.$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Tidal Horror.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Einstein-Rosen Bridge, Einstein-Rosen Core.
